## verdict
PASS: 5 tests, cgo engine in the test process, -race on, no race report, no crash. Covered: WASI p1 proc_exit status, 8 goroutines x
20 stores sharing one Engine and Module, traps (unreachable, div-by-zero, OOB) with the race runtime's signal handling, epoch
interruption driven from another goroutine (Interrupt trap), and a Go host callback called from the guest. The race detector does
not instrument the C/Rust side; this proves the Go side and the signal coexistence, not engine-internal thread safety.

## the test file (race_test.go)
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	wasmtime "github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime-go/v49"
)

func compile(t *testing.T, e *wasmtime.Engine, wat string) *wasmtime.Module {
	t.Helper()
	bin, err := wasmtime.Wat2Wasm(wat)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m, err := wasmtime.NewModule(e, bin)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return m
}

func TestRaceWasiExit(t *testing.T) {
	e := wasmtime.NewEngine()
	m := compile(t, e, watHello(7))
	l := wasmtime.NewLinker(e)
	if err := l.DefineWasi(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := wasmtime.NewStore(e)
	s.SetWasi(wasmtime.NewWasiConfig())
	inst, err := l.Instantiate(s, m)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, err = inst.GetFunc(s, "_start").Call(s)
	var we *wasmtime.Error
	if !errors.As(err, &we) {
		t.Fatalf("want *wasmtime.Error, got %v", err)
	}
	if code, ok := we.ExitStatus(); !ok || code != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("exit status = %d,%v; want 7", code, ok)
	}
}

func TestRaceConcurrentStores(t *testing.T) {
	e := wasmtime.NewEngine()
	m := compile(t, e, watCompute)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for g := 0; g < 8; g++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
				s := wasmtime.NewStore(e)
				inst, err := wasmtime.NewInstance(s, m, nil)
				if err != nil {
					t.Error(err)
					return
				}
				v, err := inst.GetFunc(s, "fib").Call(s, 20)
				if err != nil || v.(int32) != 6765 {
					t.Errorf("fib(20) = %v, %v", v, err)
					return
				}
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
}

func TestRaceTraps(t *testing.T) {
	e := wasmtime.NewEngine()
	m := compile(t, e, watTraps)
	want := map[string]wasmtime.TrapCode{"unreachable": 9, "divzero": 7, "oob": 1}
	for name, code := range want {
		s := wasmtime.NewStore(e)
		inst, err := wasmtime.NewInstance(s, m, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_, err = inst.GetFunc(s, name).Call(s)
		var tr *wasmtime.Trap
		if !errors.As(err, &tr) || tr.Code() == nil || *tr.Code() != code {
			t.Fatalf("%s: got %v", name, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestRaceEpochInterruptFromAnotherGoroutine(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := wasmtime.NewConfig()
	cfg.SetEpochInterruption(true)
	e := wasmtime.NewEngineWithConfig(cfg)
	m := compile(t, e, watSpin)
	s := wasmtime.NewStore(e)
	s.SetEpochDeadline(1)
	inst, err := wasmtime.NewInstance(s, m, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	go func() { time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond); e.IncrementEpoch() }()
	_, err = inst.GetFunc(s, "spin").Call(s)
	var tr *wasmtime.Trap
	if !errors.As(err, &tr) || tr.Code() == nil || *tr.Code() != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("want an Interrupt trap, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRaceHostCallback(t *testing.T) {
	e := wasmtime.NewEngine()
	s := wasmtime.NewStore(e)
	var mu sync.Mutex
	n := 0
	f := wasmtime.WrapFunc(s, func(x int32) int32 { mu.Lock(); n++; mu.Unlock(); return x * 2 })
	m := compile(t, e, `(module (import "" "f" (func $f (param i32) (result i32)))
	  (func (export "go") (result i32) (call $f (i32.const 21))))`)
	inst, err := wasmtime.NewInstance(s, m, []wasmtime.AsExtern{f})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	v, err := inst.GetFunc(s, "go").Call(s)
	if err != nil || v.(int32) != 42 || n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("got %v %v n=%d", v, err, n)
	}
}
